title: Virtual onsite — multi-slot sequence + final agenda confirmation
text:
Virtual onsite — multi-slot sequence + final agenda confirmation

['From: Jamie Rivera <jamie.rivera@polarishealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Recruiter <recruiter@talentlink.io>
Date: Wed, Feb 18 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Virtual onsite availability — Software Engineer II (Full-loop)

Hi Vanessa / TalentLink team,

Thanks for the invite — excited to move forward. I can do the following windows (PST):
- Tue 2026-02-24, 9:00–12:00 or 13:00–16:00
- Wed 2026-02-25, 10:00–14:00
- Fri 2026-02-27, 08:30–11:30

I prefer shorter blocks (45–60 min) with 20–30 min debrief at the end if possible. I’m on +1 PST and will need a 10 minute tech check before the first session. Attached my resume and a quick portfolio link.

Thanks — looking forward,
Jamie Rivera
Senior Backend Engineer (Contract)
Polaris Health

Attachment: candidate-resume-jamie-rivera.pdf (pdf, 220KB)', "From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamie Rivera <jamie.rivera@polarishealth.com>, Recruiter <recruiter@talentlink.io>
Date: Wed, Feb 18 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite availability — Software Engineer II (Full-loop)

Thanks Jamie — good windows. Team, can you confirm the sequence below? I'm proposing a compact virtual onsite (3 x 55min + 25min debrief) on Wed 2026-02-25 starting at 10:00 PST. Draft sequence:

1) 10:00–10:55 — System design / architecture (Marissa)
2) 11:15–12:10 — Coding / algorithmic pair (Vanessa)
3) 12:30–13:25 — Product & cross-functional (Laura)
4) 13:30–13:55 — Debrief (panel)

Notes: 15 min gaps for quick breaks and calendar buffer. If anyone needs swaps (morning vs afternoon) call them out. I've attached a panel-availability-sheet so you can mark hard constraints.

Also: Jamie requested a 10-minute tech check before 09:50 PST. Can we make sure the calendar invites include Zoom links + scribe ownership?

Attachment: panel-availability-sheet.ods (open document spreadsheet)

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Recruiting Partner, Hiring Ops
Redwood Inference
", 'From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jamie Rivera <jamie.rivera@polarishealth.com>, Recruiter <recruiter@talentlink.io>
Date: Wed, Feb 18 2026 18:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite availability — Software Engineer II (Full-loop)

On Wed, Feb 18, 2026 at 10:05 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Draft sequence:
> 1) 10:00–10:55 — System design / architecture (Marissa)
> 2) 11:15–12:10 — Coding / algorithmic pair (Vanessa)
> 3) 12:30–13:25 — Product & cross-functional (Laura)
> 4) 13:30–13:55 — Debrief (panel)
>
Sounds good. I have a hard stop at 12:15 (lead sync) so I can’t be in the last 15 minutes of slot 2. If Vanessa can take the coding session slightly earlier (11:05–12:00) that would help. Alternatively I can swap with Laura and take the product slot at 12:30 if that’s easier.

Preference: swap with Laura so I can keep the architecture deep-dive intact — but either works. Confirming I’ll own the architecture notes / score anchor.

—
Marissa Cole
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
', 'From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamie Rivera <jamie.rivera@polarishealth.com>, Recruiter <recruiter@talentlink.io>
Date: Thu, Feb 19 2026 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite availability — Software Engineer II (Full-loop)

Thanks — small tweak from my side. I can swap with Marissa for the 12:30 product slot and then move the panel debrief to 13:40–14:05 to give a 15 minute buffer after my panel. That preserves a 25 minute debrief but pushes the end time to 14:05 PST.

Also request: please include the candidate’s prompt set for coding (simple graph traversal + small performance prompt) and the scoring rubric in the shared Drive before EOD Monday so we can review.

On availability — Jamie, does 10:00–14:05 PST on Wed 2026-02-25 still work with the slightly later end?

—
Laura Bennett
Director, Product Engineering
Redwood Inference
', 'From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Rivera <jamie.rivera@polarishealth.com>, Recruiter <recruiter@talentlink.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, Feb 20 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final schedule and agenda — Wed Feb 25 (Virtual onsite)

Hi Jamie — thanks for the quick replies and flexibility. Finalized schedule below (all times PST). I’ve added Zoom links in the calendar invites and attached the full-loop-agenda PDF (includes prompts, rubric, scribe assignments, and candidate tech-check instructions).

Final sequence — Wed 2026-02-25
- 09:50–10:00 — Candidate tech check (Vanessa)
- 10:00–10:55 — System design / architecture (Marissa)
- 11:15–12:10 — Coding / algorithmic pair (Vanessa)
- 12:30–13:25 — Product & cross-functional (Laura)
- 13:40–14:05 — Panel debrief (Marissa, Vanessa, Laura)

Logistics: 15 minute breaks between panels for a restroom/coffee and calendar buffer. Please join 5 minutes early. Scribe: Marissa (architecture), Vanessa (coding), Laura (product).

Jamie — please confirm you’re set for Wed 02/25 09:50 PST for the tech check. If anything changes I’ll re-open a few backup slots on Fri the 27th.

Attachments: full-loop-agenda.pdf (PDF, 480KB)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cExampleSchedule
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=virtual-onsite-20260225

Thanks all — I’ll send calendar invites imminently.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Recruiting Partner, Hiring Ops
Redwood Inference
']
